# Decoration model credits

All models below were downloaded from their original source pages, then re-packed into single GLB files
(re-centred so y=0 is the ground, rescaled, textures embedded and in some cases downsized; several items are small
compositions of more than one source model). Original licenses apply: CC0 1.0 (public domain) or CC-BY 3.0
(attribution required, given here).
